page_title: GIR 4-3 LEG | Girona v Leganes 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Solis Romero J. E. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) is booked for saying more than Mateo Busquets Ferrer was willing to tolerate.
90+7' 6:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90+4' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Darko Brasanac leaves the pitch and Roberto Lopez (Leganes) comes on.
90+4' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oriol Romeu (Girona) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Donny van de Beek (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) gets a yellow card, off the field.
89' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul after Matija Nastasic (Leganes) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
88' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is cautioned by the referee.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier departs the field of play to be replaced by Javi Hernandez (Leganes).
87' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) attempts to discuss the decision with Mateo Busquets Ferrer, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
87' 57:43 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
85' Juan Cruz (Leganes) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
84' Renato Tapia (Leganes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
81' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Matija Nastasic (Leganes) for a tough tackle.

80' Renato Tapia (Leganes) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Paulo Gazzaniga.
80' Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
79' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) was too forceful with his tackle and Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
77' 4 - 3 Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top left corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
77' Substitution. Seydouba Cisse walks off the pitch and Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) comes on as a substitute.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Valentin Rosier (Leganes) comes onto the pitch so that Adria Altimira can be given a rest.
76' Borja Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Yvan Neyou will be replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
76' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Enric Franquesa (Leganes).

73' 4 - 2 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
72' Silvi Clua Oya comes off the pitch to be replaced by Oriol Romeu (Girona).
70' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Girona.
67' Yangel Herrera (Girona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
66' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:3.
62' 3 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Cristhian Stuani (Girona) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Marko Dmitrovic no chance!
62' It’s a PENALTY to Girona after the VAR review!
62' Michel has decided to make a change. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) replaces Bojan Miovski.

59' Play continues despite the shouts by some Girona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

59' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer sees the trip by Matija Nastasic (Leganes) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Girona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
58' The ball is cleared after Juan Cruz (Leganes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
56' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
55' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
52' Arnau Martinez (Girona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
50' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
49' Bryan Gil (Girona) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
49' The game is interrupted. Adria Altimira (Leganes) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
47' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) serves up a nice cross, but Paulo Gazzaniga punches the ball away.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' The resulting set piece from Girona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+4' CHANCE! Bojan Miovski (Girona) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Marko Dmitrovic, who reacts superbly to stop him.
45+4' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+3' Bojan Miovski (Girona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Girona as they win a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner is swung in but Girona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' Surely that's handball by one of the Leganes players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
44' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
41' 2 - 2 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Juan Cruz (Leganes) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 2:2.
41' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes).
41' Enric Franquesa (Leganes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Good clearance! Adria Altimira (Leganes) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.

38' A short pass finds Yangel Herrera (Girona). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
38' Donny van de Beek (Girona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

34' Yangel Herrera (Girona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
33' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' 2 - 1 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Arnau Martinez (Girona) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
30' Silvi Clua Oya (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

30' A neat pass is well received by Juan Cruz (Leganes), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
29' Silvi Clua Oya (Girona) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

28' Renato Tapia (Leganes) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
27' Juan Cruz (Leganes) launches a cross from the corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga is alert to thwart the effort.
27' Juan Cruz (Leganes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

24' 1 - 1 Renato Tapia (Leganes) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Darko Brasanac. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom right corner via the woodwork. 1:1!
23' Yangel Herrera (Girona) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

20' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

18' A precise low pass is received by Arnau Martinez (Girona), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
16' Bryan Gil (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
15' The linesman signals that Bojan Miovski (Girona) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
15' Girona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Donny van de Beek (Girona) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
8' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

8' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
4' Arnau Martinez (Girona) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
3' Silvi Clua Oya (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had a clear view and blows his whistle.
3' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
2' Bojan Miovski (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Girona force a corner. They send men into the box.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leganes will have the kick-off.
Mateo Busquets Ferrer is introduced as the referee for today's match.
